description: Plan your wedding with a task checklist and budget tracker in one place.

faqs.a: Use the Checklist tab to add tasks with due dates and check them off; use the Budget tab to add planned vs actual costs.
faqs.q: How do the checklist and budget work?

faqs.a: The budget tab shows planned total, actual spent, and remaining budget per item and overall.
faqs.q: What do the budget stats show?

faqs.a: Yes — both checklist and budget are stored in this browser's localStorage.
Click Export JSON to download both lists as a backup file.
faqs.q: Can I back up my plan?

howto: Add checklist tasks with optional due dates.
Check tasks off as you complete them.
Add budget items with estimated and actual costs.
Watch the totals and remaining budget update.
title: Wedding Planner
